messages:
Ava (design): Hey team — quick design review. I'm experimenting with default spline smoothing for throughput charts; wondering if we should: 1) default to no smoothing, 2) show a 'smoothing' pill in the legend, or 3) auto-smooth only when series has > 1000 points.
Ravi (eng): Leaning toward no smoothing by default. Smoothing hides spikes (bad for debugging). We can add a toggle in the legend: `Smoothing: on/off` and persist per-user.
Sam (product): For new users the smoothed line looks cleaner though. Maybe default off but use microcopy to explain: "Toggle smoothing for visual clarity; raw values shown on hover".
Ava (design): Proposed microcopy: "Smoothing is visual only — hover to see raw datapoints." Thoughts?
Maya (a11y): Two quick a11y nits: 1) legend toggles must be keyboard-focusable and announce state via aria-pressed. 2) unit labels need full text for screen readers (avoid "/s" shorthand). Example: "Requests per second" instead of "/s".
Jules (data viz): Also outliers — large spikes are common. Suggest we cap the y-axis at 99.5 percentile and show a small indicator like "+3 spikes hidden" with tooltip listing top values. That keeps charts readable without losing data.
Ravi (eng): Implementation sketch:
```
chartConfig = {
  smoothing: false, // default
  smoothingToggle: true,
  yCapPercentile: 99.5,
  outlierIndicator: true
}
```
Ava (design): Love the outlier indicator UX. For microcopy on capping tooltip: "Some values exceed the chart range — hover to see all." Short and helpful.
Sam (product): Also add a small CTA in the legend: "Show extremes" (toggles full scale). We can A/B test traffic-heavy dashboards.
Maya (a11y): Ensure the outlier indicator has an accessible label: `aria-label="3 values exceed chart range"` so screen reader users get parity.
grafana-bot: deploy: chart-component v2 deployed to staging — visual tweak for legend toggles. :rocket: 
Ravi (eng): I'll wire up the smoothing toggle + persisted preference. Can we finalize the microcopy today? 
Ava (design): Final microcopy proposal: "Smoothing hides short-term spikes — toggle to view raw points. Hover any point to see exact values." Short approval?
Jules (data viz): Fine by me.
Sam (product): Approve.
Maya (a11y): Approve from a11y standpoint if aria labels added.
Ava (design): Great — I'll push the copy to the PR and attach updated mockups. Thanks all! :tada:
